text: dsh-vision-router-inline 是供 DSH 网页端使用的视觉模型显示插件，依赖 dsh-vision-router 已加载。它保留原有视觉路由，在普通模型选择菜单中隐藏单独的视觉分组，并在对应模型旁显示图片按钮；点击按钮即可选择该模型的视觉路由。当前路由激活时，按钮也显示在模型选择器触发区和模型行。

dsh-vision-router-inline is a DSH web display companion for dsh-vision-router. It hides separate vision groups and adds a picture button beside each matching model. Clicking the button selects its vision route; the active route is marked in the picker trigger and model row.
想把视觉模型选项放回对应的普通模型旁边，别让它们单独占一个分组。
在 DSH 网页端选模型时，能不能用一个图片按钮切换到同款视觉路由？
Can I switch a model to its vision route directly from the model picker?
dsh-vision-router-inline 的功能「模型菜单视觉快捷切换」：它将单独的视觉模型分组隐藏，并在原模型选项旁显示图片按钮；点击按钮会选择对应的视觉 provider 和模型。
dsh-vision-router-inline 的功能「当前视觉路由提示」：当会话当前选择视觉路由时，插件会在模型选择器触发按钮和模型行上显示图片标记，帮助识别当前模式。

dsh-vision-router-inline README · dsh-vision-router-inline：

Display companion for [`dsh-vision-router`](https://github.com/ysr666/dsh-vision-router).

dsh-vision-router-inline README · dsh-vision-router-inline：`dsh-vision-router` adds a second provider group (`DeepSeek + 自动识图`, etc.). This plugin does not change that routing. It only changes display: fold each twin into a square picture button on the original model’s row. Click the name for the text model; click the button for that provider’s vision twin route (e.g. `google-vision` for Google). The button hover is separate from the row hover. The same button appears on the composer trigger and the Model row only while the vision route is selected.

dsh-vision-router-inline README · dsh-vision-router-inline：Example, one row:

- Gemini 3.1 Pro　□ (vision)

If [dsh-better-ux](https://github.com/MitsukiJoe/dsh-better-ux) is also installed, its large picker shows the same picture button on each card.

**This plugin does nothing unless `dsh-vision-router` is already loaded.** Install that first. If the router is missing, this package stays idle and does not wrap the model catalog.

dsh-vision-router-inline README · Requires：- [dsh-vision-router](https://github.com/ysr666/dsh-vision-router) ≥ 1.0
- DeepSeek Harness web profile

Load order: `dsh-vision-router` first, then `dsh-vision-router-inline`.

dsh-vision-router-inline README · npm：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-vision-router@latest
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-vision-router-inline@latest
```

dsh-vision-router-inline README · GitHub：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ysr666/dsh-vision-router
dsh plugin --profile web add github:MitsukiJoe/dsh-vision-router-inline
```

dsh-vision-router-inline README · Ask DSH：Send this message to DSH:

```text
Install this plugin https://github.com/MitsukiJoe/dsh-vision-router-inline
```

Restart DSH after installation.

dsh-vision-router-inline README · Update：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-vision-router dsh-vision-router-inline
```

Or send this message to DSH:

```text
Update this plugin https://github.com/MitsukiJoe/dsh-vision-router-inline
```
dsh-vision-router-inline README · Uninstall：Remove `dsh-vision-router-inline` from the web profile `package.json` and `node_modules`, restart DSH. `dsh-vision-router` itself is unchanged.
